H_protocol: H1 actual literal scene; H2 amplified disposition/intensity-transfer caution; H3 requires actual local-punchline dependence, H4 actual nonliteral license. Fantasy, dreams, staging, genre flags, metaphors, surprise and uncertainty do not by themselves warrant H3/H4.
L_protocol: L0 portable proposition; L1 material wording/rhythm; L2 register/pragmatics; L3 central Japanese form requiring reconstruction/annotation. No automatic L3 for script, idiom or literal reverse-scale feature.

records.whole_selected_premise: The former specialist must learn awkward ordinary sword work, then helps another struggling party.
records.L_rationale: Changed equipment, actual difficulty and chosen aid are portable facts.
records.H_rationale: He wants acquaintances and a favor, but actual assistance changes the fight.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Mixed motive does not cancel help; one-shot spear superiority is his counterfactual appraisal.

records.whole_selected_premise: A familiar face first recalls the princess, then is immediately recognized as a different person.
records.L_rationale: Resemblance, differentiation and a voluntary join request are portable.
records.H_rationale: Dust chooses to approach the person despite an initial wish to avoid the past.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No mistaken identity at this first meeting or printed acceptance of membership in the prologue.

records.whole_selected_premise: Urgency produces a proposed shield made of religious followers, and an actual moral objection.
records.L_rationale: The separate-matters reply and conscience challenge address the proposal rather than accepting it.
records.H_rationale: Keith proposes coercive deployment and Dust endorses it; Leen objects.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Proposal is not performed; ownership of another group is not assumed.

records.whole_selected_premise: A name barely remembered is corrected, while concern for the absent priest survives insults.
records.L_rationale: The not-even-grazing correction and named substitutions make selective attention visible.
records.H_rationale: Dust updates the tantrum assumption through Kazuma's report and Leen points out concern.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Reported letter and prior events are not new root main-volume scenes; intelligence insults are appraisals.

records.whole_selected_premise: Supposed low-level customers produce actual high-level cards and a noble public reason for staying.

records.H_rationale: Local levels contradict the conventional migration expectation and Dust objects to blocking Mitsurugi.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Cards verify selected levels, not a full census or experimentally isolated sole motive.

records.whole_selected_premise: An exclusion-sounding address redirects the strongest helper to friends, and a friend claim earns delighted assent.

records.H_rationale: Yun positively chooses the friend mission; Megumin actually shakes the collar after an insult.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not expulsion, automatic obedience or consent to physical shaking; vomiting does not occur.

records.whole_selected_premise: Dust laughs at a failed invitation he missed, then is told to inspect the supposedly disloyal companions.

records.H_rationale: Leen supplies a corrective observation against his thin-friendship account.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No invented complete Mitsurugi rejection dialogue, romance diagnosis or immediate full knowledge of the training.

records.whole_selected_premise: Concealed training leads to a real allegiance inquiry, whose price is evaded through painful child contact.
records.L_rationale: Actual inquiry, interrupted offered condition and forced saliva contact are portable.
records.H_rationale: Dust obtains the cave-training answer through coercion after recognizing a titled demon.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Holy-property mechanism is inferred after pain; no freely accepted information bargain or harmlessness exemption.

records.whole_selected_premise: A purpose slip admits idol-seeking while profession repairs the sentence, and blunt uncertainty is met with trust.

records.H_rationale: Small explains leaked shop allegiance and her decision to remain.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Hypothetical obedience if ordered is not an actual order or proof of unlimited compliance.

records.whole_selected_premise: A direct request for money becomes suspicion of fabricated danger, followed by admiration for the supposed scheme.

records.H_rationale: Merchant stays for his store and shared history; Dust identifies Leen, friends and town as protected stakes.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Merchant weapon knowledge does not establish complete knowledge of Dust's identity. Exact spear vow is conditional.

records.whole_selected_premise: Companions inferred part of the secret but the boast that they always recognize their friend fails the substitution test.

records.H_rationale: Dust actually discloses the past and dragon; friends were not wholly ignorant or wholly informed.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Prior inference is not prior complete legendary-knight knowledge; earlier princess confusion remains.

records.H_rationale: Dust declines premature attack and seeks a knowledgeable provider.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Not all ambiguous cues cause reckless confirmation; a shouted apology here is an imagined consequence.

records.whole_selected_premise: An explicit refusal remembers earlier false rewards, but a new counterfeit token induces cooperation.
